name: Shawnee Knight
review: The staff is very helpful and knowledgeable. They have a big selection on supplies for your fish. They also have a wide selection of fish. You can find different types of fish that you don't see everyday. I will definitely be coming back anytime I'm in the area. It's worth going to.

name: Sarah Proctor
review: This place is the best for all your animal needs. The staff was beyond helpful and quite knowledgable - my family and I were new fish to being fish parents. I came to this store a half a dozen times to get info and plan out my nephews first fish tank. ALYSSA IS THE BEST! she literally held my hand walked me through all my options and how to best take care of our Cory Catfish. I got set up with all the goods, tank, sand, filter. She took so much time explaining everything to me. She even played along with our lies about Santa to really make our christmas so special giving my nephew catfish, his only christmas wish. I cant thank this store enough, everything went so smooth for how complicated it was. I will never go to another pet store. Really felt welcomed and encouraged to ask questions. Alyssa was beyond awesome... but even the other staff was eager to help me. Seriously go here!!! So many kinds of fish!!!! Now we want shrimp and little glass suckers and guppies! I guess we are fish people now???

name: Schuyler Summers
review: The staff in aquatics are super helpful and friendly. They have mainly fresh water fish with a small selection of corals and occasionally macroalgae too.

name: Nathan Drysdale
review: This had been the best store for finding everything that I have been wanting to set up my tank. They also had a great selection for taking care of your birds and small mammals. One of the things that I appreciated the most about this store was that it was kept very clean and organized.

name: Derek Marks
review:
If you get into aquariums I would suggest coming here. I went to about 6 pet stores along the 405, from family owned to main brand retail and this place had the best selection in my opinion.
I judge a pet store by the smell and this store passes that test. All good pet stores have that distinct smell. If a pet store doesn’t smell like pets just walk out immediately :) all jokes aside this place has a very cool vibe to it. If anything come check out the fish and buy your dog or cat a treat.

name: Joe Tobin
review:
Being pretty new to fish keeping, I visited Sierra several times over the past month with nothing but questions about tank cycling, fish compatibility, substrate, water chemistry…you name it. I found the staff incredibly helpful and patient in answering all of my questions. Everyone I spoke with was great but Alyssa was especially knowledgeable in helping me choose the right fish for my tank setup.
No, you won’t find perfectly stocked and squared-off products on the shelves or polished floors. But it’s the slightly disorderly charm of the store that makes this place great. This is the sort of ma and pa shop full of experts and animal lovers that you are glad exists so you aren’t forced to shop solely at the Petcos of the world. Their selection of fish, plants, decorations and equipment FAR outweighs the box stores anyway. Do yourself a favor and stop by.

name: Q Z
review: I like this place! Staff are very friendly and helpful! I bought a bunny last month. This is my first time to raise baby rabbit. I felt exciting and nervous. Their staff gave me many professional advice, very patient! My bunny is very healthy now! Yay!
